claims: C1 the user role is defined as input from end users
C2 the user role is also defined as a catch-all for data OpenAI wants to provide to the model

concepts.name: user_role_message
concepts.gloss: M is a message whose role is the user role, meaning its content is input from end users or data OpenAI wants to provide to the model
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns message_role_definition/2 as the relation between a message and its role; this node's text defines what the user role is

concepts.name: message_role_definition
concepts.gloss: message M has role R, where the role specifies the message's source and determines its authority in conflicts
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text presupposes the role relation without defining it

concepts.name: user_role
concepts.gloss: the user role, one of the message roles (system, developer, user, assistant, tool)

concepts.name: end_user_input
concepts.gloss: M is a message whose content is input from an end user

concepts.name: catch_all_data
concepts.gloss: M is a message whose content is data OpenAI wants to provide to the model, used as a catch-all

ontology.gloss: M is a message with the user role
